central_question: Which Arkansas food hubs / co-ops / cold-storage / processing facilities can show audited or otherwise defensible operating cases reconstructing throughput, costs, operating margin, and free/distributable cash — without jumping from facility profit to public revenue?

cases_scored.name: Arkansas Local Food Network (ALFN)

2023.note: Expenses not fully line-itemed in secondary compile for 2023

line_items_reconstructed.throughput: NEE — no volume/lbs/SKU throughput published on 990-EZ
line_items_reconstructed.labor: PARTIAL — 990 shows minimal paid staff/contractors; not a full labor cost model
line_items_reconstructed.processing_packaging: N/A_OR_MINIMAL — online market / farmers-market aggregation, not a processing plant
line_items_reconstructed.operating_margin: THIN_ILLUSTRATIVE — ~3% of revenue in 2024 if surplus≈$4.1k on $132k

cases_scored.public_share_test: NOT_REACHED — no material free cash to allocate across ownership structures
cases_scored.reading: Real Arkansas local-food organization with audited-adjacent IRS filings. Scale is tiny relative to $13.1B cash receipts. Thin surplus is not a Replacement Stack feeder and is not a processing-facility P&L.

cases_scored.name: Arkansas Food Innovation Center at Market Center of the Ozarks (AFIC@MCO)
cases_scored.facility_scale_note: Reported ~45,000 sq ft food processing / shared kitchen facility
cases_scored.reading: Important Arkansas processing infrastructure exists. Without published throughput, fee schedule, O&M, debt, and net cash, it cannot enter COUNTABLE.
cases_scored.next_evidence: UADA/AFIC operating statements, utilization rates, fee schedule, net cash after O&M/debt

cases_scored.name: Cypress Cold Storage (Springdale expansion; NLR/Maumelle footprint)
cases_scored.facility_scale_note: 207,285 sq ft Springdale project announced; private operator
cases_scored.public_share_test: NOT_REACHED — private profit is not public cash
cases_scored.reading: Cold-chain capacity is real and relevant to External Income retention. Private warehouse P&L is not a Tax Retirement Fund feeder.

national_benchmark_context.rule: National hub benchmarks inform why facility surplus is hard — they do not invent Arkansas cash

findings.claim: Typical food hub near break-even; average profit about -2%; top quartile ~4%
findings.source: Counting Values: Food Hub Financial Benchmarking Study (Farm Credit East / Wallace Center / Farm Credit Council)

findings.claim: Typical gross margin ~14.5% of sales — thin cover for overhead/profit
Nonprofit hubs often negative before grants; for-profits near ~1% in that sample
USDA modeling treats ~5.5% of sales retained as operating profit as a viability benchmark — requires substantial sales scale
findings.source: USDA RD SR77 Food Hubs Vol. 3

national_benchmark_context.implication_for_arkansas: Even if Arkansas builds hubs, national evidence warns of thin margins. Do not jump from facility existence or farm cash receipts to reserved public cash.

ownership_gate.rule: Do not jump from facility profit → public revenue
ownership_gate.status: GATE_NOT_OPEN — no Arkansas case cleared free-distributable-cash reconstruction

evidence_chain.current: Arkansas production ($13.1B receipts) → illustrative retention → $0 COUNTABLE
evidence_chain.target_when_earned: Arkansas production → facility throughput → value added → operating surplus → reinvestment/reserves → ownership distribution → public share → reserved public cash
evidence_chain.this_slice_progress: Opened facility-case hunt; reconstructed only one tiny aggregation P&L; processing plants still NEE

states_applied_to_cases.normal: ALFN thin surplus already near zero — little buffer
states_applied_to_cases.volume_decline_or_recession: National thin-margin hubs go negative faster; ALFN-scale entities have almost no shock absorber
states_applied_to_cases.commodity_price_shock: Procurement and sales move together — margin reconstruction required before any public-share claim
states_applied_to_cases.input_inflation_or_transport_disruption: Utilities/transport/labor line items NEE for AR processing plants — cannot stress what is not bound

replacement_stack_feed.rule: No jump from facility existence or thin nonprofit surplus to Replacement Stack

headline.reading: Facility hunt finds one small Form 990 aggregation case (~$132k revenue, thin surplus) and several real facilities without public P&Ls. National benchmarks warn food hubs are thin-margin. Ownership-structure and public-share tests remain gated. COUNTABLE $0.
